ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent surge in Medicaid fraud cases in Minnesota, including the $30 million scheme uncovered by the FBI
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How can whistleblowers report suspected fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and highlight the importance of whistleblower tips in uncovering corruption
